steps.action: Public-source recovery pass for historical NOC PRISM/TOBI navigation semantics
details: JC007 processing report states that checked .nav and .cable files are passed to wireout, which dynamically models TOBI position and produces a .veh_nav file; mrgnav_inertia then correlates .veh_nav with imagery headers to calculate each ping position.

JC007 documents one example with mrgnav_inertia using a 200 m umbilical, while other cruises use materially different -u values. Therefore 200 m remains historical/contextual for CD169 unless CD169-specific provenance is recovered.
JC024 describes wireout as a physical towed-body estimate using cable drag, viscosity, sidescan/towed-body effects and a depth term related to cable length.
Historical reports show cruise/platform-specific umbilical/GPS-to-water-entry configuration varies, so generic configuration transfer to CD169 is forbidden.
JR63 independently documents weak/incorrect PRISM navigation behavior in turns and a western-longitude processing problem; this is contextual support for diagnostics, not CD169-specific calibration.
